title: NyayOS tool handoff
description: Standard handoff every tool writes to docs/ai/tool-output/<tool>/<A-nnn>.md. The file is Markdown; scripts/ai/state.mjs parses its **Field:** lines and ## sections into this object and validates it. Contract: docs/ai/TOOL_OUTPUT_CONTRACT.md.

deployment.description: 'none', or 'staging: <https URL>' under FA-001. Production is never allowed (FA-002 not granted).

sections.description: Section headings present, in order of the contract.
